intro.title: Mud Pyramid (Terracotta)
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of terracotta Pyramids with accurate geometry. Pyramids are great Vastu enhancers and Vastu rectifiers which energises the surrounding it is placed in, by generating fire energy in the middle. These pyramids with hollow structure on the inside are more effective in comparison or fibre or plastic pyramids as even the Original pyramids of Egypt are made with mud. We have 9, 81, single and multi-layer pyramids which can be used for small area like room small room or huge structures like factories.
